description.value: Askew's Foods is a locally owned independent supermarket in downtown Salmon Arm, founded in 1929 and still family-run across four locations in the Shuswap and Thompson-Okanagan region. The downtown store on Lakeshore Drive carries a full range of groceries with dedicated produce, meat, and deli departments, and sources from local farmers and suppliers. For touring cyclists passing through Salmon Arm, it is a well-established full-service resupply point in the heart of town.
